class.description: Polygon2DResourceInspector Concrete Inspector Plugin mounting a `Polygon2DControl` (`Polygon2DCanvas` + shape/offset/winding tools) whenever a `Polygon2DResource` is inspected in the Godot Editor. Part of IdeamGeometry (2D/3D polygons, Voronoi diagrams, SDF grids, and tensor fields).
